item: Stoplist batch 8: twelve Japanese attribution tails, and the ring-map leftovers of the T5 follow-ups
key_paths: configs/stopwords_extra/ja.yml configs/stopwords_extra/PROVENANCE.md tests/test_analytics_extract.py src/static/app-insights.js src/analytics/queries.py tests/ring_caveat_node_test.js tests/test_ring_caveat_i18n.py tests/clickthrough_b20_node_test.js tests/test_clickthrough_b20_maps.py tests/test_ui_ring_map.py tests/test_stopword_batch.py
summary: Twelve Japanese attribution tails (としています とコメント と強調 と指摘 と指摘した と振り返った と振り返り と振り返る と語る と説明 を発表 を発表せず) join ja.yml: the same kind as the kept と述べた and, for を発表 and を発表せず, the bare and negated forms of the を発表した and を発表しました that batch 6 already hides; every one a high-confidence N with the blind repeat agreeing, none refused by the tool; the event verbs (を発売 が登場 を紹介) stay out because they say what happened. Also: a ring map whose draw failed is no longer redrawn by a language switch, an answer that arrives after a newer group was picked (or the picker cleared) is dropped by a request ticket, the no-host guard and the loading clear are pinned, the alias refusal tests cover vi tl as and the hand-review file in their three-letter spellings (and, for rows, ko-KR vi_vn TGL), and the node test takes the endpoint's own method sentence.
